req.title: Redirect preserves relative or absolute style
req.statement: The system shall emit relative URLs on /redirect/<n> and absolute URLs on /absolute-redirect/<n>.
triggers: redirect preserves relative or absolute style

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/<n> emits relative URLs (no scheme/host) and GET /absolute-redirect/<n> emits absolute URLs (with scheme+host). The source shows redirect_n_times uses _external=False for relative and _external=True for absolute. Key test axes: (1) positive: relative redirect has no scheme, (2) positive: absolute redirect has scheme+host, (3) boundary: n=1 (minimum valid, special-cased in source), (4) boundary: n=2 (first non-trivial chain), (5) negative: n=0 triggers assert failure (400/500), (6) decision-table: ?absolute=true query param switches /redirect/<n> to absolute mode. Mutation targets: the string comparisons 'absolute'/'relative', the boolean _external flag, the assert n>0 guard, and the startswith checks on Location header.

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_relative_location_no_scheme
preconditions: n=1 is the minimum valid redirect count
expected: Location header starts with '/' (relative, no scheme or host)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_relative_location_no_scheme():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location.startswith('/'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location}'
    assert not location.startswith('http://'), f'Should not be absolute: {location}'
    assert not location.startswith('https://'), f'Should not be absolute: {location}'

test_redirect_n1_relative_location_no_scheme()

def test_redirect_n0_boundary_assert_error():

    assert r.status_code in (400, 404, 500), \
        f'Expected error status for n=0, got: {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 302, 'n=0 must not produce a redirect'

tests.name: test_redirect_chain_n3_each_hop_relative
preconditions: n=3 exercises multi-hop relative redirect chain
expected: Each intermediate Location is a relative URL
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: all hops in /redirect/<n> chain must be relative
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_chain_n3_each_hop_relative():
    r = client.get('/redirect/3', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    loc1 = r.headers['Location']
    assert loc1.startswith('/'), f'Hop1 not relative: {loc1}'
    assert '://' not in loc1, f'Hop1 has scheme: {loc1}'
    r2 = client.get(loc1, follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    loc2 = r2.headers['Location']
    assert loc2.startswith('/'), f'Hop2 not relative: {loc2}'
    assert '://' not in loc2, f'Hop2 has scheme: {loc2}'
    r3 = client.get(loc2, follow_redirects=False)
    assert r3.status_code == 302
    loc3 = r3.headers['Location']
    assert loc3.startswith('/'), f'Hop3 not relative: {loc3}'

test_redirect_chain_n3_each_hop_relative()

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_absolute_true_location_contains_host
expected: Location contains 'localhost' or a host component
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: absolute URL must include host, not just path
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_absolute_true_location_contains_host():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location.startswith('http://') or location.startswith('https://'), \
        f'Expected absolute URL with scheme: {location}'
    assert 'localhost' in location or '127.0.0.1' in location or len(location.split('/')[2]) > 0, \
        f'Expected host in absolute URL: {location}'
    assert '/get' in location, f'Expected /get endpoint in absolute URL: {location}'

test_redirect_n1_absolute_true_location_contains_host()
